title: Pure Imperial traps
summary: The Imperial Traps archetype centers on the lockdown synergy between Imperial Custom and face-up Continuous Traps. Because Continuous Trap Monsters remain Continuous Trap Cards while in the Monster Zone, Imperial Custom makes Statue of Anguish Pattern, Angel Statue - Azurune, and Apophis the Swamp Deity completely immune to destruction by both battle and card effects. Protected from backrow sweeps by Imperial Custom and Lord of the Heavenly Prison, the deck systematically dismantles the opponent's board before finishing with Uria, Lord of Searing Flames.

allow.Statue of Anguish Pattern: Level 7 EARTH Rock Continuous Trap Monster (0 ATK / 2500 DEF) that cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, becomes completely indestructible by battle and card effects under Imperial Custom, and destroys 1 card on the field every time a Trap Monster is Special Summoned!
allow.Angel Statue - Azurune: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Continuous Trap Monster (1800 ATK / 1800 DEF) that becomes indestructible by battle and card effects under Imperial Custom and sends itself to the GY to negate an opponent's Special Summon!
allow.Apophis the Swamp Deity: Level 6 EARTH Reptile Continuous Trap Monster (2000 ATK / 2200 DEF) that becomes indestructible by battle and card effects under Imperial Custom and negates face-up cards your opponent controls up to the number of other Continuous Traps you control!
allow.Zoma the Spirit: Level 4 DARK Zombie Continuous Trap Monster (1800 ATK / 500 DEF) that becomes indestructible by battle under Imperial Custom!
allow.The Despair Uranus: Level 8 LIGHT Rock that directly sets Imperial Custom or Imperial Iron Wall from your Deck when Tribute Summoned, gains 300 ATK per face-up Continuous Spell/Trap, and protects face-up Continuous Traps from destruction.
allow.Lord of the Heavenly Prison: Level 10 DARK Rock (3000 ATK) that reveals itself in hand to protect all Set Imperial Traps before they are flipped face-up!
allow.Skill Drain: Limited to 1 in TCG: Continuous Trap protected from destruction by Imperial Custom that negates all Effect Monsters on the field.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Limited to 1 in TCG: Counter Trap that protects your Continuous Traps from Spell/Trap wipes.
allow.Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max: Rank 10 Xyz made with Uria, Lord of Searing Flames + Lord of the Heavenly Prison to inflict 2000 burn damage.
allow.Gallant Granite: Rank 4 Rock Xyz made with two Level 4 Trap Monsters that searches The Despair Uranus or Lord of the Heavenly Prison from the Deck!

main: Imperial Custom

Core Continuous Trap: face-up Continuous Trap Cards cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, except 'Imperial Custom'—making Imperial Iron Wall AND all of your Continuous Trap Monsters completely indestructible!
Imperial Iron Wall
Signature Continuous Trap (protected from destruction by Imperial Custom!): neither player can banish cards from anywhere.
Statue of Anguish Pattern

Continuous Trap Monster: Special Summons itself as a Level 7 Rock (0 ATK / 2500 DEF) that cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, cannot be destroyed by battle or effects under Imperial Custom, and destroys 1 card on the field every time another Trap Card is Special Summoned as a monster!
Apophis the Swamp Deity
Continuous Trap Monster: Special Summons itself as a Level 6 Reptile (2000 ATK / 2200 DEF) and negates face-up cards your opponent controls up to the number of other Continuous Traps you control!
Angel Statue - Azurune

Continuous Trap Monster: Special Summons itself as a Level 4 Fairy (1800 ATK / 1800 DEF), cannot be destroyed by battle/effects under Imperial Custom, and sends a Continuous Trap Monster to the GY to negate an opponent's Special Summon!
Zoma the Spirit
Continuous Trap Monster: Special Summons itself as a Level 4 Zombie (1800 ATK / 500 DEF) and cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while Imperial Custom is face-up.
Uria, Lord of Searing Flames

Iconic Level 10 Pyro boss: Special Summons itself by sending 3 face-up Traps you control to the GY, gains 1000 ATK/DEF per Continuous Trap in your GY, and destroys 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls each turn.
Hyper Blaze

Continuous Trap (protected by Imperial Custom!) that lets Uria use face-down Traps for its Summon, gives Uria +1000 ATK/DEF for every Trap on the field and in the GYs during battle, and discards 1 card to recover or revive Uria!
The Despair Uranus
2900 ATK Rock searchable by Gallant Granite that sets Imperial Custom or Imperial Iron Wall directly from your Deck and gains 300 ATK for every Continuous Trap you control.
Lord of the Heavenly Prison
3000 ATK Rock that reveals itself in hand to protect all Set cards on the field until you flip Imperial Custom face-up.
Skill Drain
Limited to 1 in TCG: Continuous Trap (indestructible while Imperial Custom is face-up!) that negates all face-up Effect Monsters on the field.
Solemn Judgment
Limited to 1 in TCG: Counter Trap that negates Spell/Trap wipes to protect your Continuous Traps.
extra: Rank 4 Rock Xyz (summoned using Angel Statue - Azurune + Zoma the Spirit!) that detaches 1 material to search Lord of the Heavenly Prison or The Despair Uranus directly from your Deck!
Rank 10 Xyz made with Uria, Lord of Searing Flames + Lord of the Heavenly Prison to inflict 2000 burn damage.
